ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.ea_guid, o.Name, o.Object_Type, o.Package_ID FROM t_object o WHERE o.Name = 'ROOT1' OR o.Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Name = 'FBT-ROOT') ORDER BY o.Object_ID
SELECT p.Package_ID, p.ea_guid, p.Name, p.Parent_ID FROM t_package p WHERE p.Name LIKE 'FBT-ROOT%' OR p.Name = 'EA Addins'
